newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo feeder cattle prices steady-off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo feeder cattle prices steady-off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt lower, compared to last week, USDA said. Bulk supply Medium and Large 1-2 400-850 lb feeder steers and 400-700 lb feeder heifers. Trade moderate. Demand moderate on thin-fleshed feeder cattle and light on fleshy offerings. Feeder steers and heifers under 600 lbs 42 percent, over 600 lbs 56 percent with cows and bulls around 2 percent of total supply.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 78.50-83.00, several lots 675-700 lbs fleshy 74.50-77.50; 700-800 lbs 75.30-77.25; 800-900 lbs 73.80-75.20; load 947 lbs fleshy 65.25. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-600 lbs 76.75-83.50; pkg 615 lbs 78.75; part load 759 lbs 72.00, small lot 745 lbs 67.50; few 800-850 lbs 68.00-69.00.
